intro.text: A princess from a kingdom called Dormancy, who comes to Diggen's Point as Dirk's wife and the duke's daughter-in-law.

items.text: After Charlie disappeared, she married the duke's new heir, Dirk, and so became daughter-in-law to the duke of Diggen's Point.

appearance.text: Thought very beautiful, with rosy cheeks, shining hair and fine features.
